summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The m+ DualYield Autocall ETF (MPDY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed to pursue high monthly income with reduced downside risk by using swaps to track a laddered portfolio of 52 to 312 synthetic autocallable notes referencing a leveraged volatility-managed S&P 500 futures index. MPDY was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by m+ Funds.
